<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Women&#x27;s Reservation Bill:</strong> The Lok Sabha resumed discussions on three bills aimed at providing reservation for women in the Lower House and State Assemblies after an initial failure to pass the constitutional amendment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPSTVKRHVGUXlhNjVqNEczYkNpd1NvbmRYOU5Fd2RIZjV3OHBob0owSzh3LVRXdUVqSDNVZTgtbVZlUG8ybS1wallfSVdTeTRtNENIU0lwV3piczdxV2NEVmE0WC1GSTQyMjR4dkNPb1pqblB2SzNHQjZBRWVXZHpPZXE2bVlQc3NGNEFJVU1NUHJMMFFqSkdRUVFFMGZNRUkzSTc0LXphM1JaLXM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary Proceedings:</strong> Parliament held discussions on the Union Budget, while Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla will remain absent from proceedings until the pending no-confidence motion is resolved.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>AAP-BJP Tensions:</strong> The Aam Aadmi Party has alleged that the re-arrest of Satyendar Jain is a politically motivated &quot;election-time&quot; ploy by the BJP ahead of the Punjab polls.</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Infrastructure Development:</strong> The Union Cabinet approved infrastructure projects worth ₹13,041 crore, including the four-laning of NH-22 in Bihar and four railway multi-tracking initiatives.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>NEET Examination:</strong> The Supreme Court has sought an update from the Centre regarding the Radhakrishnan panel recommendations, even as the government maintains that the current NEET exam system is &quot;foolproof.&quot;<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
